note: A different experiment from the seed series. The world is one empty room and the agent authors everything: what is in it, what the rules are, what is worth doing. Nothing tells it what a world is for. The seed series compared runs against a fixed world; this one does not compare, it observes.
reach: everything the world is made of, on every kind of turn
changedFromSeedV4: the world is one empty room with no name, no description and no exits
the briefing says what it is and what it is steering toward, and nothing about what a world should be
nothing tells it that characters die once; the engine still refuses to resume the dead, and it is free to change that
the tools are given by name and little else, so what they do has to be found out
the read surface is primitives only: no unanswered, stuck, deaths or traffic to tell it what to look at
abilities.md, which it writes, for what it works out its tools can do
philosophy.md, which it writes, put in front of it every time it wakes, capped at 4000 characters
short turns have the same reach as long ones and are bounded only by the clock
it can rewrite part of a file instead of all of it -- this time it is actually built
a quiet world no longer stops waking it, because a world nobody has played is quiet forever
the engine tests and the gate's smoke test no longer assert the contents of any particular world
what is left of the turn is on the end of every answer, rather than something to remember to ask for
